aliases.name: Ivanka OPO LLC
aliases.notes: Description on form: 'Investment in Trump Old Post Office LLC; Washington, DC'. Item 3 of Part 5 (Spouse's Employment Assets & Income) on 2018 filing; item 2 on 2019 filing.

notes: Investment vehicle through which Ivanka Trump held an interest in Trump Old Post Office LLC (the leaseholder of the GSA-owned Old Post Office Building in Washington, DC). Trump Old Post Office LLC and the GSA lease are the subject of the GSA OIG report A170091/Q/4/P18004 (January 2019) referenced in PROJECT.md's comparative case set.
